description: Dept. of Census & Statistics - National Consumer Price Index for the month of January 2020
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index for January 2020, as computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content is purely statistical and informational, relating to economic data publication. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). This falls under general administrative/statistical announcements, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
